As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the battle marks the beginning of [[0 ABY]], the Assault, including Lajaie's [[death]], must take place around [[1 ABY]]. All those with access to pods, evacuate.|Lajaie giving final orders prior to his death|}} '''Lajaie''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[Alliance Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]], first serving as a [[major]] within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Massassi Group]], and subsequently serving as a [[Navy|naval]] [[commander]] and [[commanding officer]] of [[Beta Group]]. Lajaie was [[Death|killed]] in action during the [[Battle of Mako-Ta]], when [[Lajaie's cruiser|his cruiser]] was destroyed by the ''[[Executor]]'', the [[flagship]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] Imperial [[Death Squadron]]. ==Biography== ===Battle of Yavin=== Lajaie, a [[human]] [[Gender|male]], served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]],{{FilmDate|IV|1}} shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Lajaie was a [[Alliance officer|rebel officer]] with the [[military rank]] of [[major]],{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}} and was present at the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]] when the [[Death Star plans|schematics]] of the Empire's [[planet]]-[[Death|killing]] [[superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], were received by the Alliance. Major Lajaie accompanied [[General]] [[Jan Dodonna]], [[Colonel]] [[Feyn Gospic]], and others in immediately examining the information in order to devise a strategy to destroy the Death Star. After a weakness was discovered in the Death Star, Lajaie accompanied General Dodonna in his briefing to the [[rebel pilot]]s on how to destroy the [[battle station]]. Lajaie was present with other Alliance personnel monitoring the battle, which was eventually won when the [[Force-sensitive]] [[pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker]] managed to fire [[proton torpedo]]s into the station's thermal exhaust port, which destroyed the main [[reactor]] and commenced a chain reaction which claimed the station, killing nearly every Imperial who was on board, save for [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. In the aftermath of the battle, Lajaie was present in a ceremony where Skywalker and [[Han Solo]], [[captain]] of the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', received the [[Medal of Bravery]]. ===At Mako-Ta Space Docks=== {{Quote|This is a shame, but also not a surprise. If a full fleet is impossible, there's other strategic initiatives we can consider—''"
"''I wasn't finished, commander.|Lajaie, during the rebel meeting before being interrupted by Leia Organa|}} After a failed meeting with [[Mon Calamari]] [[Regent]] [[Dors Urtya]] on [[Mon Cala]] in an attempt to recruit the [[Mon Cala Mercantile Fleet]], Lajaie, serving as a naval [[commander]], was present at the [[Mako-Ta Space Docks]] in a meeting of [[Alliance High Command]] when [[Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)|Chancellor]] [[Mon Mothma]] requested the report on Mon Cala by [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. As Organa pointed out that Urtya would not revolt against the Empire, Lajaie reacted by stating that it was a shame but also not a surprise that Mon Cala would not rebel, and continued by stating that if a full fleet was impossible to obtain, there were other strategic avenues that could be considered. Organa interrupted, and outlined her plan to rescue [[King of Mon Cala|King]] [[Lee-Char]], in order to secure an alliance with the Mon Calamari and add the [[fleet]] into their own [[Rebel Alliance Navy|naval forces]]. Eventually, Organa and [[Heroes of Yavin|her team]] were able to breach a [[Unidentified Imperial base (Strokill Prime)|prison]] on [[Strokill Prime]] and find Lee-Char. Too injured to move, they recorded his final words before he was [[Death|killed]] by Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s.[[Star Wars (2015) 48|''Star Wars'' (2015) 48]] Although Urtya was able to recover the recordings from Organa, he sent the message to the [[Fleet Captain]]s of the Mon Cala fleet, resulting in their [[Mutiny on Mon Cala|mutiny]] and defection to the Rebel Alliance.[[Star Wars (2015) 49|''Star Wars'' (2015) 49]] ===Imperial ambush=== {{Quote|If any of you make it, inform everyone that the problems are caused by certain circumvents in the hardware. I believe they all source to Shu-Torun systems. It's possible some bypasses are still operational.|Lajaie, giving final orders to his crew|}} [[File:BetaGroup-2015StarWars50.png|thumb|left|250x300px|Lajaie leads Beta group.]] After the successful rebellion, Commander Lajaie was given command of a [[Lajaie's cruiser|cruiser]] that had been refitted for combat by the [[Kingdom of Shu-Torun]], on order of [[Queen]] [[Trios]]. Lajaie used the [[Unidentified Mon Calamari cruiser (Geist)|cruiser]] as the [[flagship]] of [[Beta Group]], and was present at the Mako-Ta Space Docks during a ceremony celebrating the new Alliance Fleet where rebel personnel and rebel allies where to witness the dispersal of the rebel [[Navy|naval]] forces. As the ships were ready to launch into [[hyperspace]], an error prevented the launch of the Willard's cruiser, as well as all the other ships that had been refitted with [[Shu-Torun]] technology. The fault resulted in the failure of all launches, lost communications, disabled armament, and the ships being unable to launch their [[starfighter]]s. At the same [[time]], [[Death Squadron]], under the command of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Vader, [[Battle of Mako-Ta|arrived]] and fired on the nearest cruiser, General [[Vanden Huyck Willard|Vanden Willard's]] flagship ''[[Yavin's Hope]]'', destroying it. During the time since the attack had commenced on the rest of the fleet, Lajaie was almost able to isolate the problem, and found crucial information on restoring the systems of the fleet, although his [[cruiser]] was attacked before his [[starship]]'s systems could return to operational status. After he was informed that the cruiser's [[Deflector shield|shields]] were failing, he was aware that it was too soon to bring his vessel to operational status, he ordered the evacuation of his cruiser. As he ordered the evacuation, the informed his crew that if anyone was able to survive, that they had to inform the other rebels that the problems were caused by circumvents in the hardware sourced to Shu-Torun systems, and it was still possible that some bypasses were still operational. As the crew evacuated on [[escape pod]]s, the cruiser was annihilated and exploded into a fireball. Imperial starfighters and [[turbolaser]]s then focused fire on the pods, destroying several. ==Behind the scenes== Lajaie first appeared as an uncredited Rebel extra in the Yavin 4 scenes of the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]]. In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the character's first name was established as "[[Evram Lajaie|Evram]]."{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Commander Evram Lajaie}} Within the [[2016]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', an individual resembling the Rebel bigwig Lajaie was present within the [[Great Temple]]'s [[council room]] situated behind [[Jan Dodonna]], during Jyn's address to the [[Alliance Cabinet]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' [[Kieron Gillen]], lead writer of the [[Star Wars (2015)|''Star Wars'']] [[Marvel Comics]] series, was the one who came up with killing off Lajaie, as he thought about how the heroes rose through the ranks so quickly.{{Twitter|kierongillen|status/1083315031297703937|[[Kieron Gillen]]|quote=I did. I came from me thinking "how did our heroes climb the ranks so quickly?" and the answer being "a huge disaster which created a lot of places in CoC."|archivefile=File:KieronGillen-Death-January-10-2019.png}} ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars (LINE Webtoon)|''Star Wars'' LINE Webtoon]] *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: A New Hope Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: A New Hope'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *[[Star Wars (2015) 45|''Star Wars'' (2015) 45]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 50|''Star Wars'' (2015) 50]] *[[Star Wars (2015) 52|''Star Wars'' (2015) 52]] {{1stID|Lajaie}} *[[Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon 4|''Han Solo - Hunt for the Falcon'' 4]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *{{SWE|characters|lukeskywalker|Luke Skywalker}} {{Po}} *{{SWE|characters|r2d2|R2-D2}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|26|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|49|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Po}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}} *{{GoS|Connections (Star Wars Galaxy of Sounds)}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|General Equipment (2)}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|rebel-alliance|Rebel Alliance}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Lajaie |ja=ラジャイ |ka=ლაჯაიე |pl=Lajaie}} [[Category:Alliance Military officers]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Majors]] [[Category:Males]]
